figures.caption: For h=diag(3,1) and k=[[5/4,3/4],[3/4,5/4]], the exact tail gap areas are 1/2 and 1, totaling 3/2. The original density difference has eigenvalues 2 and -1/2 and norm 5/2. The attained minimum trace of a positive common majorant is 9/2.

figures.caption: The densities 2P_e1 and 2P_(1,1) have identical tails but distinct rank-one spectral projections. Their original norm distance is 2 sqrt(2), and their unitary-orbit distance is zero. The coordinate diagram depicts only the real slice of the complex spectral lines.
figures.assumptions: Ordinary trace on M2(C); spectral cutoff 0<t<2; P_v denotes the orthogonal projection onto C v.
